# Frame returns to its show after a Immich restart
### Fixed
- **A frame could stay stuck in the always-on program after an Immich restart** although a show was set for it (for example two frames with different shows suddenly looking the same). If the display drops out because photos cannot be loaded, it returns to the show after 30 seconds. In addition, the server re-sends the show to a device that sits in the always-on program while a show is set for it (at most once a minute, not during night rest).

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
